title_zh: 核对工厂学徒岗位和工资条件

scenario.goal_zh: 核实岗位经验要求、培训机会和报酬

context_zh: 求职者询问一份虚构的工厂学徒职位，确认培训和薪酬条件后准备申请。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Niko
sentences.text: Could you explain the apprentice role at your factory? I have no experience with machines.

sentences.speaker: Daisy
sentences.text: You would help the fitting team while learning from a supervisor. We train new starters, so experience is not required.

sentences.speaker: Niko
sentences.text: What is the starting salary, and can it rise during the training?

sentences.speaker: Daisy
sentences.text: It starts at twenty-two thousand pounds a year. It increases after you pass each of the two training assessments.

sentences.speaker: Niko
sentences.text: I have a profile on your jobs website already. Can I use that to apply?

sentences.speaker: Daisy
sentences.text: Yes. Update your details, select this vacancy, and add a short explanation of why you want the training.

sentences.speaker: Niko
sentences.text: Thank you. I will update it and prepare that explanation tonight.
